stories.title: Fauci grilled in Senate hearing on COVID origins and lab research
new_facts: Fauci invoked Fifth Amendment over 100 times; Paul, Birx, Gounder react on CBS.
GOP eyes contempt; Fifth Amendment invocations may test Biden pardon, per legal experts.
Birx references Fauci's diaries as topic of hearing discussion.
Rand Paul says there is a "very real chance" Fauci could be prosecuted.
Fauci's private notes described as deeply embarrassing and instructive.
Trump says he watched the entire 3-hour-plus hearing; Fifth Amendment count specified as 111.
Senate committee plans vote next week on whether to recommend holding Fauci in contempt.
stories.line: Fauci testified before Senate Republicans who pressed him on COVID origins and lab funding; Paul suggested potential prosecution.

stories.title: Fed holds rates steady as stock market tumbles, officials split on path
new_facts: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh held press conference after July 29 policy meeting.
Fed held rates steady for fifth time; 9-3 vote with three dissenters preferring a quarter-point hike; first three-dissent vote in a decade.
US borrowing costs at 19-year high as Fed holds rates steady.
Dow closes down over 1,000 points following Fed rate decision.
Hold decision seen as win for Trump but contrasts with Warsh's own hawkish rhetoric.
Federal funds rate held in range of 3.5% to 3.75%.
stories.line: Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged despite inflation concerns and market pressure, with three officials dissenting in favor of raising rates.

stories.title: NASA's Roman Space Telescope set for August launch; SpaceX wins military contracts
new_facts: NASA Roman Space Telescope set to launch Aug. 30 on SpaceX Falcon Heavy.
SpaceX wins $1.6B US Space Force contract for 18 Falcon 9 launches through 2027.
SpaceX launching secret US spy satellite reconnaissance mission July 30.
stories.line: NASA's Roman telescope launches in August; SpaceX books military contracts for Falcon 9 launches.

stories.title: Altman meets White House on AI regulation ahead of framework deadline
new_facts: Sam Altman visited Capitol Hill and said he supports legislation to slow AI development.
Altman meeting with White House's Susie Wiles and other Trump administration officials this week ahead of AI framework deadline.
stories.line: OpenAI's Altman is meeting White House officials before a deadline to develop AI regulation framework.

stories.line: Glen Hansard, Irish musician and Oscar winner for the film 'Once,' died in a motorcycle crash.

stories.title: Russia strikes Kyiv as Zelenskyy warns of escalating attack
new_facts: Explosions reported in Kyiv after Zelenskyy warned of imminent Russian massive attack.
Putin orders probe after Navy Day parade canceled over Ukraine strike fears; replaced by scaled-down event mocked publicly.
stories.line: Russia launched strikes on Kyiv as Ukraine's president warns of planned escalation; Russia investigates failed naval parade.

stories.title: FIFA pursues $20 billion private investment deal for World Cup stakes
new_facts: FIFA plans new subsidiary to run part of World Cup, offering 20% stake to private investors.
Infantino defends $20bn FIFA commercial venture amid backlash; calls it 'opportunity not obligation'.
Infantino sets September 19 deadline for federations to decide on private investor scheme; Joshua Kushner named as investor.
44 drones and $9 million in fake FIFA merchandise seized in Houston during World Cup; man faces prison for drone flight.
UEFA calls emergency meeting of 55 members Thursday; European boycott of FIFA tournaments under consideration.
Infantino published a 15-page Instagram post during the World Cup bemoaning 'hate and false rumours'.
stories.line: FIFA president Infantino is pursuing a $20 billion deal to sell stakes in World Cup competitions to private investors, drawing fierce opposition from UEFA and national federations.

stories.title: Microsoft surges on cloud growth as Meta's cash flow craters despite revenue gains
new_facts: Microsoft logged $3.2B gain from Anthropic investment; OpenAI investment was mixed.
Meta stock plunges ~10% on weak revenue guidance and dwindling free cash flow.
Meta Q2 free cash flow $784M, down 91% YoY; 2026 capex guidance raised to $130B-$145B.
Meta Q2 revenue $60.8B (+28% YoY); daily active people 3.6B; META drops 10%+ after hours.
Microsoft Q4 revenue $90B (+18% YoY); net income $35.8B (+31%); Cloud $59.3B; MSFT +3% after hours.
stories.line: Meta's free cash flow collapsed 91% year-over-year while raising capex forecasts; Microsoft's cloud business grew 27% on strong earnings.

stories.title: Meta misses earnings as Zuckerberg bets on unproven AI agents
new_facts: Zuckerberg says Meta's enterprise AI opportunity spans agents, APIs, compute, and internal software.
Zuckerberg previewed a vision for personal AI agents acting on users' behalf.
Meta stock tumbled ~8% after weaker-than-expected Q2 earnings; Zuckerberg published WSJ op-ed Tuesday on AI.
stories.line: Meta missed earnings targets and stock fell 6% as Zuckerberg pivots heavily toward AI agents, betting the company's future on a technology that hasn't yet generated revenue.

stories.title: Fox News Poll: Democratic enthusiasm may decide North Carolina Senate race
new_facts: Fox News poll: NC Democrats more enthusiastic than Republicans, 51% vs 42% extremely interested in midterms.
Roy Cooper leads Michael Whatley by 9 points in North Carolina Senate race per Fox News poll.
stories.line: Fox News polling shows Democratic voter enthusiasm could be a decisive factor in North Carolina's Senate election.
